values.note: Full hookup $40 a night March 20-November 9; every site is electric only at $30 November 10-March 19. Tent camping $15. A deposit is taken by card at booking.

fees.source: https://hermannmo.com/campground/ ('Full hookup (water, electric, and sewer) $40.00 (March 20th-Nov 9th)'; 'Electric only $30.00 (Nov 10th-March 19th)'; 'Tent camping $15.00'; 'Deposits will be collected at the time of the reservation'), read 2026-11-07

hookups.source: https://hermannmo.com/campground/ ('51 sites with full hook-ups (water, electric, & sewer)'; 'All sites are electric only Nov 10th-March 19th'), read 2026-11-07. No city page states an amperage; the note's 30/50A is cleared.

sites.source: https://hermannmo.com/campground/ ('51 sites with full hook-ups') + ResNexus site list (back-in sites in the Bathhouse and Pool Parking Lot areas, 'Pull Through RV Site' #s in the Bathhouse area; site 6 'No Room for slide-outs ... this is a small site'), read 2026-11-07

values.note: Bathhouse showers and restrooms; the pool's showers are open to campers from Memorial Day through late summer. Dump station by the park office.

facilities.source: https://hermannmo.com/campground/ ('Dump station by Park Office, west of swimming pool'; 'Access to Bathhouse showers and restrooms'; 'Access to swimming pool interior showers and restroom after Memorial Day through late summer'), read 2026-11-07

season.source: https://hermannmo.com/campground/ (winter rate 'Electric only $30.00 (Nov 10th-March 19th)'; 'All sites are electric only Nov 10th-March 19th'), read 2026-11-07

values.note: All RV reservations are online, one site per reservation. Reservations for the coming year open in early January (2027's on January 4 at 10 am). During Wurstfest, Maifest and Oktoberfest weekends a person may book at most 2 sites. Check-in 2 pm, check-out 11 am. Tent camping needs no reservation.

booking.source: https://hermannmo.com/campground/ ('All reservations are online'; '2-night minimum stay required for all weekends (Friday/Saturday or Saturday/Sunday)'; '2027 RESERVATIONS WILL OPEN ON JANUARY 4TH AT 10:00 A.M.'; festivals 'limited to 2 sites per person'; 'Check-in time is 2:00pm & Check-out time is 11:00am') + ResNexus ('you can only book one Site Per Reservation'), read 2026-11-07

note: City of Hermann campground in the town's city park, by the pool, ball fields and courts; local shuttles pick up at the campground for Hermann's attractions. Set inland in the park, not on the river. --Claude
summary: City page confirms 51 full-hookup sites, $40 summer / $30 electric-only winter, year-round, online via ResNexus with a 2-night weekend minimum; amperage (note-only) cleared; the note's '8 electric-only' split isn't on the city page.
flags: HOOKUPS: the note said 43 full-hookup 30/50A + 8 electric-only; the city says all 51 sites are full hookup (electric only in winter, Nov 10-Mar 19) and states no amperage - electric cleared to null (ResNexus shows generic 30/30+/50+ filter options only, not per-site amps).
BOOKING: ResNexus (the city's engine) recorded as platform 'operator'; ResNexus listed 25 sites on its first page and the per-night availability calendar wasn't read.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed - the park sits inland in town; the only water near the sites is a ~0.2-acre ornamental pond and Frene Creek ~150 m east past the park road.
PIN: stored 38.6980,-91.4420 sits at the pool beside the bathhouse sites; the pool-lot and southern loop sites are within ~200 m - inside the bound, no move.
